name: @gridspace/raster-path
description: Terrain and Tool Raster Path Finder using WebGPU

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:web && npm run build:shaders
scripts.build:web: mkdir -p build && cp src/web/*.html src/web/*.css src/web/*.js build/ && cp src/index.js build/raster-path.js && cp src/etc/serve.json build/
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.test: npm run test:planar && npm run test:radial
scripts.test:planar: npm run build && npx electron src/test/planar-test.cjs
scripts.test:planar-tiling: npm run build && npx electron src/test/planar-tiling-test.cjs
scripts.test:radial: npm run build && npx electron src/test/radial-test.cjs
scripts.test:batch-divisor: npm run build && npx electron src/test/batch-divisor-benchmark.cjs
scripts.test:work-estimation: npm run build && npx electron src/test/work-estimation-profile.cjs
scripts.test:workload-calibration: npm run build && npx electron src/test/workload-calibration.cjs
